description: User-reported screenshot regression: a fresh Telegram question is accepted and worked for minutes without any visible receipt. Runtime policy/config has display.platforms.telegram.start_ack=true, but current core has no sender path. Restore the generic configured start-ack behavior and prove it fails open.
acceptance: A fresh non-command Telegram turn sends configured start_ack_text before background processing.
Slash commands do not receive the fresh-turn start acknowledgement.
Acknowledgement send failure does not block the real user turn.

evidence.summary: RED reproduced: configured Telegram start_ack produced no visible send before handler work. Restored generic adapter sender from vetted carry commit a0b4c8b5b with current-branch conflict resolution preserving newer queue-copy assertions. GREEN: HERMES_HOME=/tmp/hermes-tg-ack-final2 ./venv/bin/pytest tests/gateway/test_gateway_delivery_compact.py tests/gateway/test_busy_session_ack.py tests/gateway/test_start_ack.py -q -o 'addopts=' => 36 passed; py_compile passed; git diff --check passed.
